{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Lightweight athletic hoodie, relaxed boxy cut, hip length, charcoal grey, soft cotton blend fleece.
High-waisted wide-leg yoga pants, straight relaxed fit, ankle length, deep heather navy, stretch jersey knit.
Minimalist slip-on loafer, classic rounded toe, low heel, matte black, smooth vegan leather (adhering to the request for no sneakers or restrictive footwear).

This outfit seamlessly bridges the gap between a morning yoga session and a relaxed coffee catch-up with a friend. The loose hoodie and wide-leg pants allow for maximum freedom of movement during exercise while maintaining a polished, put-together look once she changes into her casual clothes. By choosing sleek slip-on loafers instead of athletic sneakers, the ensemble respects her specific wish to avoid standard running shoes even during active wear, adding a touch of refined everyday style suitable for autumn daylight."}
